title: Portsmouth Harbor kayak rescue
description: Coast Guard Petty Officer 3rd Class Perry Derrenbacher and New Hampshire Marine Patrol Officer Nick Haroutunian talk about a rescue of a kayaker at the mouth of the Piscataqua River that occurred Thursday, January 26, 2017. Derrenbacher was one of the crewmembers of Station Portsmouth Harbor's 47-foot Motor Lifeboat that rescued the kayaker. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Andrew Barresi)
keywords: N.H., kayak, 47-foot Motor Lifeboat, hypothermia, Andrew Barresi, paddlecraft, cold water rescue, Portsmouth Harbor, Coast Guard Station Portsmouth Harbor, Coast Guard, SAR, search and rescue, USCG
